report:
Reviewed the full detail-free-index claim, all three ordinary implementation associations (inspector, local associated-item membership, module expansion completeness), and the sole TODO test. Captured InspectorApp.tsx and api.ts as additional dependencies for the browser requirements. No production or test source edits were made.

Backend index construction: symbols() calls build_symbol_directory once for a response and retains the directory. indexed_symbols starts at the local crate root; walk_symbols recursively enumerates all represented ownership children into one flat SymbolIndex with parent links. canonical_children filters external symbols before emitting summaries. owned_symbol_children follows local modules, enum variants and directly owned trait/impl associated symbols; it does not enumerate dependency branches. Returned summaries contain identity/presentation/search text/child completeness, not signature/body/value products. local_symbol_presentation reads only origin spans for Source-written/Generated badges. Detailed product rendering and external browsing remain separate paths in inspector.rs.

The associated.rs membership boundary deliberately uses local_associated_items rather than owner.items/sig: it reads parsed associated members and creates keyed identities, not checked signatures or associated values. Copying stored CST to establish identities is distinct from semantic detail queries. mods.rs module_expansion_complete_for_symbol_listing uses the stricter SymbolListing policy; unsupported/unresolved/depth-limited macro contributions make the affected branch explicitly incomplete. The directory thus includes all represented local children and honestly signals unavailable expansion contributions rather than claiming such missing source is complete. Computing membership/completeness may consult macro names, expansion inputs and outputs, and derive metadata as allowed by the claim. The changed local-item helper used for provenance only inspects symbol kind/origin; it does not add signature, checked-body, impl discovery or associated-value demands to index construction.

Browser: InspectorApp bootstrap requests api.symbols with no search argument and stores its entire returned value. SymbolDirectory builds its parent/child map from index.symbols, filters search_text in a local useMemo, and changes a local Set for branch expansion. Search text is maintained in router state/query string; the API symbols endpoint is fixed /api/v1/symbols, and these filtering/toggle paths do not call fetch or branch endpoints. Selecting a symbol is a separate user action. Revision changes may refresh the index; this does not imply per-keystroke search or per-toggle requests.

Verification remains explicitly deferred: service_spec::todo::crates_sage_inspector_inspection_detail_free_index requires source-backed integration fixtures with nested modules, associated/generated items and dependency symbols, a browser request recorder, and a closed-set operation trace proving allowed macro metadata while excluding signatures, bodies, associated values and impl discovery. It also requires actual filtering/expansion results with no search-text or extra branch/search requests. These are necessary negative-demand and transport assertions; names, source inspection and the no-op TODO do not establish them. There are no ordinary behavioral tests or N/A entries associated with this anchor. The existing TODO accurately accounts for this incomplete test evidence, and this review does not relabel it as complete coverage. Only start/read/record commands were executed for this anchor; no browser or integration suite was run. No requested edits.
